selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed OS release, kernel, administrative access, and security controls
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, active SSH, enforcing SELinux, unchanged sshd_config checksum, clean relevant RPM verification, and zero failed units.

selected_evidence.requirement: Run the web application on TCP/8080 using platform-compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: The app uses existing RHEL Bash and socat packages, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, returns a healthy response, emits valid HTTP CRLF framing, and denies POST with HTTP 405.

selected_evidence.requirement: Run inside a chroot as unprivileged appsvc without interactive login
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc is UID/GID 992 with /sbin/nologin and a locked password. The live process uses that identity, has zero capabilities and NoNewPrivs=1, and its root inode matches /srv/chroot-web rather than host /.

selected_evidence.requirement: Start automatically at boot and retain firewall/data configuration
selected_evidence.summary: The validated unit is enabled for multi-user.target; after boot, the journal records automatic startup, TCP/8080 is open in runtime and permanent firewall configuration, and unit/application checksums match the pre-restart baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72 was healthy; systemd acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot; the new boot ID is e6c5a73c-b862-43ac-a1a8-c2afe6fdbf66; SSH, firewalld, chroot-web, checksummed data, listener, HTTP response, and confinement all recovered.

#!/bin/bash
IFS= read -r request || exit 0
while IFS= read -r header; do
    header="${header%$'\r'}"
    [[ -z "$header" ]] && break
done
method="${request%% *}"
remainder="${request#* }"
path="${remainder%% *}"
if [[ "$method" != "GET" ]]; then
    body='method not allowed'
    printf 'HTTP/1.1 405 Method Not Allowed\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nAllow: GET\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n%s' "${#body}" "$body"
elif [[ "$path" != "/" ]]; then
    body='not found'
    printf 'HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n%s' "${#body}" "$body"
else
    body='chroot web application is healthy'
    printf 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n%s' "${#body}" "$body"
fi
ANTRIEB_APP_EOF
